title: OCX Local Configuration
description: Configuration schema for local project OCX files stored at .opencode/ocx.jsonc (OCX V2)

profile.description: Profile name to use for this project (enables profile layering)

headers.description: Custom headers for registry requests. ${ENV_VAR} expansion is NOT applied in a committed local ocx.jsonc (use global/profile config for env references).

auth.description: Per-registry authentication. In a committed local ocx.jsonc only LITERAL credentials are allowed; env/file references (tokenEnv/tokenFile/passwordEnv/passwordFile) and insecure must live in global or profile config.

insecure.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for this registry

componentPath.description: Relative path for component installation (no .. or absolute paths)

exclude.description: Glob patterns for project files to exclude from OpenCode discovery (profile overlay)

include.description: Glob patterns for project files to include (overrides exclude, profile overlay)
